basic_profile.bio: I'm a 22-year-old college student based in the Midwest, pursuing a degree in computer science with a minor in digital art. I have a strong interest in gaming, particularly Minecraft, which I play regularly with friends. I enjoy experimenting with game mods and server hosting in my free time. When I'm not gaming, I like to dive into political discussions or explore new social platforms. I'm usually online during the evenings, and I work part-time as a tech support representative. I'm single and enjoy the flexibility of my schedule, allowing me to balance studies, work, and my hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid understanding of computer systems and software from both my college courses and personal projects. I learned the basics of programming in high school, which sparked my interest in computer science. I often self-teach through online resources and community forums to enhance my skills, particularly in game development and server management.
